text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired (PDT-78901) — inference-gateway(us-west1) 5xx rate spike >5% over 5m. Alert group: http_5xx_rate. Suspected impact: gen-serving -> model-proxy upstream 502s. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx

maya (oncall): acked. I'm on it, assigning to liam for infra triage.

liam (sre): I'm looking. quick check: tails show lots of upstream 502 with `retry_count` ballooning. Could be retry-loop causing amplifying errors.

chen (infra): I see autoscaler activity — several model-serving nodes OOMed and restarted ~2m ago in us-west1-a. Possibly bad rollout + increased traffic.

maya (oncall): initial mitigation: 1) disable canary routing to new model variant 2) reduce client retries to 1 for now 3) route a % traffic to eu-west1 fallback. Can someone run the routing switch?

liam (sre): doing routing swap now.

```bash
# move 30% traffic to eu-west1 via routerctl
routerctl route set inference-gateway --region eu-west1 --weight 30
```

liam (sre): routerctl accepted, changes propagated (uid 0x8f3). Watching metrics.

ops-bot: deployment-check: disabled canary for model-variant v2.2 by maya. autoscaler paused: true.

chen (infra): scaling up model-serving pool in us-west1 by +4 nodes (p-type-gpu-32).

```bash
kubectl scale deployment model-serving -n prod --replicas=12 --context=us-west1
```

chen (infra): kicked a KV-cache prewarm job to warm prefix caches.

maya (oncall): customers: product-alerts, can we post a short Impact note? Which customers hit?

product-alerts: quick check — error spikes affected API keys with heavy streaming (alpha partners). No billing impact yet; increased latency and failed requests for some streaming calls. Internal severity: SEV3 -> SEV2 if persists.

liam (sre): graphs: 5xx rate peaked at 9.2% at T+3m, now down to 3.8% after routing swap and scale. Latency p95 improved from 1.9s -> 1.2s.

maya (oncall): good. keep routing at 30% until we confirm. Next steps: disable retry-exponential backoff client-side for 10m (reduce amplification), confirm no degraded nodes, and start a gradual canary rollback for the model variant if restarts correlate.

chen (infra): nodes stabilized, OOMs look tied to model-variant v2.2 memory allocation bump. Rolling rollback initiated for the canary pods.

```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-serving -n prod --to-revision=58 --context=us-west1
```

maya (oncall): noted. I'll hand off to liam for validation and monitoring while I log this in incidents. If 5xx rate stays <1% for 15m we'll close PD.

liam (sre): running post-mit checks: tailing proxy logs, sampling failed traces, verifying KV hit rate. If we still see 5xx after rollback we'll throttle incoming streaming concurrency at the edge.

pagerbot: PagerDuty incident PDT-78901 updated: acknowledged by maya, status: investigating.

product-alerts: sent status update to impacted customers: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors for some streaming requests in us-west1; failing requests may result in retries. We're routing traffic to fallback region and scaling capacity. More updates in 15 minutes."

maya (oncall): quick TL;DR for handoff: cause suspected model-variant memory regression -> OOM -> retry amplification -> 5xx spike. Actions taken: routing shift 30% to eu-west1, scale +4 nodes us-west1, disabled canary, rolled back model variant, reduced client retries. Current status: 5xx rate ~0.9% and trending down.

liam (sre): confirm: metrics stable. I'll take on-call for next 45m. maya feel free to step out.

maya (oncall): handing off to liam. I'll file incident ticket with root cause hypothesis and postmortem owners: liam (SRE), chen (Infra), sara (research/model).

liam (sre): noted. I'll collect logs and attach diagnostic bundle: s3://redwood-incident-bundles/PDT-78901/1718609999.tar.gz

ops-bot: Reminder: create Sev-2 postmortem if incident duration exceeds 60m. Currently elapsed 34m.

maya (oncall): thanks everyone. If liam sees re-escalation ping @maya.

liam (sre): will do. monitoring alerts set: 1) 5xx_rate >1% for 10m -> page 2) sustained OOM restarts -> page infra.

pagerbot: PagerDuty incident PDT-78901: status changed to "mitigated" (manual) by liam.

liam (sre): closing notes: mitigation successful, rolling postmortem scheduled. I'll keep the thread updated with final RCA.

maya (oncall): closing handoff. :thumbsup:
